answer: The jetty schedule is applied in cipher and ridge exposes each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1126 identities would post 873 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
